issuer_capacity.finding: LOC metadata names James K. Polk as creator; on January 12, 1848 he was serving as President. The cataloged grouping's title points to instructions for John Slidell, but the held manuscript sequence visually examined is principally rough drafts of a message to the House responding to its request for those instructions. No signature, authentication, dispatch, or receipt establishes that the pages are the actual instruction issued to Slidell. The draft's presidential authorship/capacity is plausible from context, not independently authenticated from the pages.
issuer_capacity.confidence: high that the catalog describes a Polk Papers / House-message draft grouping; low that the examined pages themselves are the issued Slidell instructions.

date_verified.finding: LOC metadata and finding-aid description assign January 12, 1848. Page 0795 bears a handwritten '1848 Ja. 12' notation; page 0806 labels a rough-sketch message draft 'Jan'y 1848'. These establish the associated manuscript packet/draft's cataloged date context, not the date of a separately issued instruction to Slidell.

original_page_matches_text.finding: The Stage 22 workbench has no transcription. I inspected the 16 page-linked images 0795–0810: LOC master TIFF for page 0795 and LOC IIIF 25%-scale derivatives for pages 0796–0810. Page 0806 expressly heads a rough sketch of a first draft of a Message to the House in answer to its call for instructions to Slidell; pages 0807–0810 are marked 2–5 and continue that draft. Pages 0796–0802 are also a House-directed draft/report discussing the requested instructions and negotiations. The 25%-scale pages are too reduced/faint for a reliable diplomatic transcription; no transcription comparison is possible.

operative_clause_inventory.text: Rough Sketch of first draft of Message to the House of Representatives in answer to their call for instructions to Mr Slidell, Minister to Mexico. Jan'y 1848.
Narrative/referential discussion of prior instructions, negotiations with Mexico, and the congressional request. No separate imperative addressed to Slidell is established from this draft sequence.
A separate numbered manuscript draft/report addresses the House and discusses resolutions, negotiations, and Slidell-related materials; it is not established as instructions dispatched to Slidell.
Refers to an order issued to Commodore Conner. Treat as a distinct referenced instrument/loose text, not a Slidell instruction; identity, date, and relation to the cataloged group remain unresolved.

historical_inclusion_proposal.reason: The evidence establishes a Polk Papers catalog/finding-aid grouping dated January 12, 1848 and related draft presidential communications concerning a congressional request for instructions to Slidell. It does not establish that the examined pages are the actual presidential instruction issued to Slidell. The proposed historical unit is an issuance, not a catalog title, draft, or later report about an instruction. Hold this item outside the admitted count until the executed/issued instruction is located and its relationship to these drafts is resolved; do not treat the page 0804 Conner reference as the same instrument.
historical_inclusion_proposal.confidence: high that admission is unsupported on present record; no exclusion recommendation because the underlying instruction may be elsewhere or not yet identified.
